desc: Derive the prime-exponent characterization: \(|v_p(S_i)-v_p(S_{i+1})|=v_p(A_i)\), while the global gcd condition is equivalent to minimum exponent zero for every prime.
Design and prove the per-prime nonnegative-height DP with a zero-visited condition and weighted score contributions.
Determine suitable DP state bounds using \(\sum_i v_p(A_i)\), and optimize transitions for \(N\leq 1000\), \(A_i\leq 1000\).
Factor all \(A_i\), collect exponent sequences for every occurring prime, and combine their per-prime answers modulo \(998244353\).
Prove independence across primes and confirm that multiplying per-prime weighted sums exactly equals the required sum of sequence scores.
